overview: Embark on an enchanting journey through the breathtaking landscapes of Gangtok and Darjeeling, where the majestic Himalayas set the stage for unforgettable experiences. Your adventure begins with a scenic transfer to Gangtok, the vibrant capital of Sikkim. Stroll along M.G. Marg, immersing yourself in the local culture through its lively markets and eateries. On Day 2, marvel at the stunning Tsomgo Lake, perched at 12,310 feet, and visit the revered Baba Mandir, a site of spiritual significance. As you continue to Darjeeling, rise early for a magical sunrise at Tiger Hill, where the snow-capped peaks of Kanchenjunga are bathed in golden light. Explore the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, the serene Japanese Temple, and enjoy the thrilling Darjeeling Ropeway ride. This captivating tour not only showcases natural beauty but also invites you to connect deeply with the rich culture of the Himalayas, leaving you with cherished memories that will last a lifetime.

days.title: Arrival In Gangtok
days.body: Upon your meet and greet with our representative at Bagdogra Airport or at NJP Railway Station, a transfer will be arranged to the peaceful hill station of Gangtok (130 Km/5 hrs.) Check-in at your hotel in this beautiful destination and start to get familiar with your surroundings. In the evening, set out on a shopping spree along the roads of the main market area M.G Marg. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

days.title: Excursion To Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir
days.body:
After breakfast, prepare for a full-day excursion to the glacial Tsomgo Lake (12,310 feet), and the temple of Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir (a very holy site for all) - at a short distance of only 40 km from Gangtok. Home to the Brahmini ducks and many migratory birds, the 1-kilometer-long lake is oval-shaped and nearly 50 feet deep. The surface reflects different colors with the change of seasons and is revered by the local Sikkimese folk. Spend the evening in Gangtok doing recreational activities such as shopping and having a delicious local dinner. Overnight stay in Gangtok.
NOTE: In case of a Landslide or for any reason, Tsomgo Lake is closed. We will provide alternate sightseeing. NRIs, OCIs, PIO Card holders, and foreign nationals are not allowed to visit Baba Mandir and Nathula Pass. They are allowed to visit Tsomgo Lake with a valid permit.

days.title: Gangtok Half Day Sightseeing Tour & Transfer To Darjeeling
days.body: After breakfast go for local sightseeing covering Jhakri Water Falls along with Do-rul Chhorten, Research Institute of Tibetology (Closed on Sunday), Directorate of Handicraft & Handloom (Closed on Sunday), and Flower Show. In the afternoon, prepare for your transfer to Darjeeling (7100 ft / 115 km / 4-5 hrs). Evening free for leisure. Overnight at Hotel.

days.title: Darjeeling Full Day Sightseeing Tour With Tiger Hill
days.body:
Spend your day today witnessing a magnificent sunrise over the Himalayas and exploring local tourist attractions. To watch the blaze of rapidly changing colors of the snow peaks as the sun strikes, set out early in the morning, before dawn (4 am), to the highest point in Darjeeling Tiger Hill (2590 m) - for views of a breathtaking sunrise and its reflection rays over the Kanchenjunga Ranges and other impressive Himalayan peaks. On the way back to your hotel, visit Batasia Loop and Ghoom Monastery. Expected arrival time at hotel: 7 am.
After freshening up and a hearty breakfast at your hotel, visit the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute (closed on Thursday), Padmaja Naidu Zoological Park, Darjeeling Ropeway Ride (Ticket cost not included & will be approx INR 180.00 per person), Tenzing - Gombu Rock, Tibetan Refugee Self Help Centre (closed on Sundays), Japanese Temple & Peace Pagoda, and panoramic view of Tea Estate. End your lovely city tour day with an overnight stay at a hotel in Darjeeling.

days.title: Departure From Darjeeling
days.body: After you have finished your breakfast, a transfer will be arranged to Bagdogra Airport/ NJP Railway Station from the hotel (distance from Darjeeling to Bagdogra Airport: 110 kms/3 hrs). Your tour in Darjeeling has ended. Let the memories begin!
